description: B2: Speed-sorted handlers inside one action use the Speed from the last updateSpeed (between actions), not the live Speed. Froslass's Icy Wind lowers both p2 actives, each holding an Eject Pack: Swampert (Speed 100) and Blissey (Speed 99) become 66 and 66 after the drop. At the AfterMove Showdown still sorts them by the pre-drop speeds, so Swampert always ejects first and Blissey follows at the replacement's switch-in batch; an engine reading the live Speed sees a tie and draws the order. A miss leaves only the other holder to switch. Damage rolls: extremes.
